LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Bloodrage.nodes.0.label: Bloodied Resolve
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Bloodrage.nodes.0.descrip: Retains original missing-health damage, health and defense. Later nodes count a wounded hit only when your overall health is 65% or lower at ordinary attack resolution and actual damage is dealt to a standing enemy. They do not drain health or use bleeding rate. Progression stays with the item.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Bloodrage.nodes.1.label: Wounded Surge
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Bloodrage.nodes.1.descrip: A wounded hit deals 75 bonus damage, once per 8 seconds. Abilities and secondary damage do not trigger it. Base rewards: damage 75.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Bloodrage.nodes.2.label: Bloodied Stand
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Bloodrage.nodes.2.descrip: A wounded hit shields you for 50 base points over 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. The shield neither raises health percentage nor heals injuries. Base rewards: shield 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Bloodrage.nodes.3.label: Breath in Battle
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Bloodrage.nodes.3.descrip: After Wounded Surge deals actual bonus damage, heal 20 base points of your recoverable injuries, once per 8 seconds. Permanent scars and missing parts are not restored. Base rewards: healing 20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Bloodrage.nodes.4.label: Bloodied Cleave
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Bloodrage.nodes.4.descrip: After Wounded Surge deals actual bonus damage, strike one other enemy within 3 cells of the impact and clear sight for 25 damage, once per 8 seconds. Never substitutes the original target. Base rewards: damage 25.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Bloodrage.nodes.5.label: Bloodbound Cover
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Bloodrage.nodes.5.descrip: A wounded hit also shields the nearest other eligible colonist within 4 cells and clear sight for 50 base points over 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Resolves separately and never substitutes you when no ally is eligible. Base rewards: shield 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Bloodrage.nodes.6.label: Unbroken Momentum
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Bloodrage.nodes.6.descrip: A wounded hit stores one charge of momentum for 5 seconds. A later ordinary hit consumes it for 50 bonus damage, even after recovering above 65% health. One charge maximum, with an 8-second creation cooldown. Base rewards: damage 50.
